items.text:
It's certainly unique. This has a lot of potential to be a cult classic. What it sorely needs is a slider for the "mortgage payment" so new players can get used to it. Once you overcome that there's not much more content though. Still the content it has is enough for the price, it's quite an experience anyway. 

+ The random hull blow outs keeps you on edge.
+ I liked being able to set up my ship.
+ The realism is striking.

- There's a need for 32x or 64x even though it's tolerable at 16x when you're waiting for things to get done. 
- I couldn't figure out how to lock a door or reset a code and a guy named Conner kept coming on board to steal my stuff.
- There were a couple things that seemed like bugs but I couldn't really tell. Like I was able to steal things off the base station.
- The conversation system is awkward.
- Path-finding needs a little work.

I don't normally write reviews but I wanted to say you should support this and I hope the developers get it polished up a bit. I like the road map. This game could die but if it succeeds it will be nothing short of unique in gaming and that's saying something.
items.text_zh:
它确实很独特。这很有潜力成为一部邪典经典。它迫切需要的是一条“房贷还款”滑块，这样新玩家就能慢慢适应。一旦你克服了这一点，内容其实就不多了。不过就价格而言，它现有的内容已经足够了，无论如何这都是一种相当独特的体验。

+ 随机的船体爆裂让你时刻提心吊胆。
+ 我喜欢能够配置自己的飞船。
+ 真实感非常惊人。

- 需要32倍甚至64倍加速，虽然16倍在等待事情完成时也还能忍受。
- 我搞不懂怎么锁门或重置密码，一个叫Conner的家伙老是上船来偷我的东西。
- 有几件事看起来像是bug，但我也说不准。比如我居然能从基地站偷东西。
- 对话系统很别扭。
- 寻路系统需要改进一下。

我通常不写评测，但我想说你们应该支持这款游戏，我希望开发者能把它打磨得更好一些。我喜欢他们的路线图。这款游戏可能会夭折，但如果它能成功，那在游戏界将是独一无二的，这话可不是随便说说的。

observations.evidence_zh: 寻路功能需要再改进一下
